question_text: Find the 7th term in the expansion of (4/x³ + x²/2)¹⁴.

mark_split.label: Write T₇ from the general term

recall_prompt: Say how you would find the 7th term — which r you use in the general term, and how the powers of 4, 2 and x combine.
insider_note: Take r = 6, and combine the constants through base 2: 4⁸/2⁶ is a single power of 2. The x-powers subtract to leave x¹² in the DENOMINATOR — subtracting the wrong way puts it on top.

steps.label: Write T₇ from the general term
steps.margin_note: First mark. The 7th term is Tᵣ₊₁ with r = 6: ¹⁴C₆ times the first entry to the power 14 − 6 times the second to the power 6.
lines: In (x + y)ⁿ, Tᵣ₊₁ = ⁿCᵣ xⁿ⁻ʳ yʳ

recall.must_convey: That the 7th term is T₆₊₁ = ¹⁴C₆ (4/x³)⁸ (x²/2)⁶.
accept: the seventh term is r equal to six in the general term, fourteen C six into four by x cubed to the eight into x squared by two to the six
use T r plus one equals n C r x to the n minus r y to the r with r six
T seven is fourteen C six times four by x cube power eight times x square by two power six
seventh term ante r six, fourteen C six four by x cube power eight x square by two power six
r is one less than seven

steps.why: The r-th power of the second entry appears in the (r + 1)-th term, so the 7th term has r = 6, never 7.
common_mistakes: Using r = 7 and getting the 8th term.
Swapping the two entries so 4/x³ gets the power 6.

steps.label: Combine the powers

recall.must_convey: That the powers combine to ¹⁴C₆ · 4⁵/x¹².
accept: four to the eight by two to the six is two to the ten which is four to the five, and x twelve by x twenty four is one by x twelve
the seventh term is fourteen C six into four to the five over x to the twelve
combine the powers of two and of x to get fourteen C six four power five by x power twelve
powers combine cheste fourteen C six four power five by x power twelve
x to the twelve over x to the twenty four leaves x to the twelve below

steps.why: Writing 4 as 2² lets the 4⁸ and the 2⁶ combine into one power; the x powers subtract because the x is in the denominator.
common_mistakes: Getting x¹² in the numerator by subtracting the wrong way.
